headline: Forza Horizon 6's PS5 launch delayed to January 2027
summary: Playground Games delayed Forza Horizon 6's PS5 launch to January 26th, 2027, pushing back a release previously expected in 2026. The game's first expansion will also arrive early next year.

claims.statement: Forza Horizon 6 on PS5 is now officially launching January 26th, 2027.
